# netcup_user_image_download (Ephemeral Resource)

The download of an uploaded image of the netcup SCP user (SCP REST API). It needs Terraform 1.10 or newer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
ephemeral "netcup_user_image_download" "example" {
  key = "disk.img"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Name of the image at netcup.

### Read-Only

- `filename` (String) Name of the file.
- `headers` (Map of List of String, Sensitive) Headers to send with the download.
- `presigned_url` (String, Sensitive) Download URL.
- `presigned_url_validity_duration_in_hours` (Number) Validity of the URL in hours.
